features.text: TARGETED LUMBAR STABILIZATION: Extends to T-9 for comprehensive spinal support.
CUSTOM COMPRESSION PANELS: Provide adjustable pressure for optimal disc decompression.
BREATHABLE LOW-PROFILE DESIGN: Can be worn discreetly under clothing for daily use.
THERAPEUTIC ALIGNMENT: Promotes natural posture and reduces strain on the lower back.
UNIVERSAL SIZING: Fits 23-50 inches waist, expandable up to 66 inches with extension belt.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
